original.readme:
Multiple .csv files stored inside parc-stats directory.


## Metadata

To specify which atlases are used to generate the parcellation, please set `parcellations` key in the product.json.

```json
{
    "parcellations": [
        "aparc",
        "aparc.a2009s",
        "aparc.DKTatlas",
        "gordon333dil",
        "yeo17dil",
        "hcp-mmp-b",
        "schaefer100-yeo17"
    ]
}
```

!!! There could be multiple parcellations

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Group statistics and machine learning on regional anatomy or diffusion measures.

**Not for:** Mixing tables from different parcellations; set the parcellations metadata key.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 21 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.parc-stats.json

files.desc: Directory of CSV tables, one row per parcel (or per subject and parcel).

identifying_risks: Rare conditions or small samples can make participant-level values identifying
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Remove subject and session columns beyond participant codes before public release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when averaged across enough participants that no individual can be singled out
Tier 4 when used to predict traits or profile individuals

inputs_of.name: Compile parc-stats csvs across project into one dataframe
inputs_of.purpose: concatenates a chosen parc-stats CSV from many subjects into one group table

intended_use: Group statistics and machine learning on regional anatomy or diffusion measures.
not_suitable_for: Mixing tables from different parcellations; set the parcellations metadata key.

outputs_of.name: Compile parc-stats csvs across project into one dataframe
outputs_of.purpose: concatenates a chosen parc-stats CSV from many subjects into one group table

outputs_of.name: Compute Anatomical Statistics
outputs_of.purpose: computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics

outputs_of.name: Compute dice similarity coefficient between parcels in parcellations
outputs_of.purpose: computes the Dice similarity coefficient of each parcel between a parcellation and a reference parcellation

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from Freesurfer Parcellation (volume)
outputs_of.purpose: computes volume, cortical thickness and mean diffusion measures

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from Parcellation (volume)
outputs_of.purpose: computes volume, cortical thickness and mean diffusion measures

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from subcortical segmentation
outputs_of.purpose: computes mean diffusion measures

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface
outputs_of.purpose: computes per-ROI summary statistics

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface - Freesurfer computations
outputs_of.purpose: computes per-ROI statistics of cortex-mapped diffusion measures

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to visual regions binned by eccentricity - Benson14
outputs_of.purpose: computes mean diffusion measures and FreeSurfer anatomical measures

outputs_of.name: Compute summary statistics of visual regions binned by pRF - Benson14 - Anatomical Stats
outputs_of.purpose: computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics

outputs_of.name: Extract anatomical statistics inside data mapped to cortical surface
outputs_of.purpose: computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics

outputs_of.name: Extract anatomical statistics inside tract endpoints mapped to cortical surface
outputs_of.purpose: computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics

outputs_of.name: Extract diffusion metrics inside ROIs
outputs_of.purpose: extracts summary statistics

outputs_of.name: Extract summary measures within tissue types
outputs_of.purpose: computes the mean and standard deviation of diffusion

outputs_of.name: Extract summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface inside tract endpoints
outputs_of.purpose: computes summary statistics

outputs_of.name: Freesurfer Longitudinal Statistics
outputs_of.purpose: computes longitudinal cortical change

outputs_of.name: Freesurfer Statistics
outputs_of.purpose: converts FreeSurfer recon-all stats for a chosen cortical parcellation into tidy CSV tables of per-parcel

outputs_of.name: Parcellation Statistics - Surface
outputs_of.purpose: computes per-parcel cortical surface statistics

outputs_of.name: Parcellation Statistics - Volume
outputs_of.purpose: computes volume and cortical thickness of every ROI in a volumetric parcellation

outputs_of.name: Postprocess parcellation: island removal & inflation
outputs_of.purpose: remove islands (unconnected components) from and/or inflate a given volumetric parcellation

outputs_of.name: Seed-based Correlation
outputs_of.purpose: computes a seed-based functional connectivity map from BOLD fMRI
